description: Source code for the high-level SFNT driver interface in the FreeType project, including functions for accessing SFNT tables, glyph names, PostScript names, and service definitions.

methods.name: get_sfnt_table
methods.description: Retrieves specific SFNT table data from a font face based on the provided tag.

methods.name: sfnt_table_info
methods.description: Provides information about a specific SFNT table, including its tag, offset, and length.

methods.name: sfnt_get_glyph_name
methods.description: Retrieves the glyph name for a given glyph index in a font face.

methods.name: sfnt_get_name_index
methods.description: Finds the index of a glyph given its name.

methods.name: sfnt_get_ps_name
methods.description: Retrieves the PostScript name of the font face.

methods.name: sfnt_get_charset_id
methods.description: Gets the charset ID and registry for BDF fonts.

methods.name: sfnt_services
methods.description: Defines the list of services supported by the SFNT module.

methods.name: sfnt_get_interface
methods.description: Retrieves a specific interface from the SFNT module based on the provided name.
